title: Cash Starting Figure by Item Class for Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts Cash Settlements
content:
When a homeowner takes cash in place of a Bridgewell replacement under a Homeowner Service Contract (a customer-elected settlement), the cash starting figure follows what Bridgewell no longer provides once the customer takes cash. It is built from the amount recorded on the replacement authorization the cash replaces:

| Item replaced | What Bridgewell no longer provides | Cash starting figure |
|---|---|---|
| refrigerator, clothes washer, clothes dryer, or oven range and cooktop | delivery and connection | the recorded amount less 300.00 |
| heating system, cooling system or water heater | licensed installation | the recorded amount multiplied by one less 0.30 (that is, by 0.70), rounded to the cent |
| any other item | — | the recorded amount as it stands |

**Valuation examples (hypothetical recorded amounts).**
- Refrigerator recorded at 1,450.00: 1,450.00 less 300.00 gives 1,150.00.
- Water heater recorded at 1,333.33: multiplied by 0.70 gives 933.331, rounded to the cent 933.33.
- Dishwasher recorded at 880.00: the recorded amount as it stands, 880.00.

**Basis Q&A.**
*Is the 300.00 deducted for a dishwasher?* No; the dishwasher is not among the items in the delivery-and-connection row, so its starting figure is the recorded amount as it stands.
*When is the licensed-installation figure rounded?* At the cent, as soon as the 30% share has been removed.
